judgement.reason: The single Khoj server image runs with managed PostgreSQL; the sandbox, computer and search services are optional, and the model cache can be re-downloaded.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 3 application services (sandbox, computer, server). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The computer service is optional and enabled only when KHOJ_OPERATOR_ENABLED is set, and the production image runs a single gunicorn web process; the sandbox may still need vendor confirmation.

evidence.quote: # Set KHOJ_OPERATOR_ENABLED=True in the server service environment variable to enable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume khoj_computer:/home/operator (docker-compose.yml computer), volume khoj_config:/root/.khoj/ (docker-compose.yml server)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that the khoj_config directory /root/.khoj/ holds only a cache or data that a managed service replaces.
